market: Europe Polyamide Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The polyamide hot melt adhesives market comprises thermoplastic adhesives based on dimer-acid or bio-derived polyamide resins offering high heat and chemical resistance. It measures sales of finished adhesives for electronics, automotive and footwear bonding. BY RAW MATERIAL: Dimer-Acid Polyamide, Bio-Based Polyamide, Other Polyamides. BY PROCESSING METHOD: Low-Pressure Moulding, Conventional Hot Melt Application. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Electronics Encapsulation & Overmoulding, Footwear & Textiles, Packaging, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: EVA, polyolefin, polyester and SBC hot melts; polyamide engineering plastics and fibres; reactive PUR hot melts. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
